blocks.content: Let's now quickly revise what we have learned so far in this chapter:
In C++, the syntax to create a string is similar to that of a variable.
We use the cout object to print a string.
We can change the character of a string by assigning a new character at that position.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
